title: Clarifying Bandwidth and Network Settings for a team

question.author: member_052
question.body: Before I explain bandwidth and network settings to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Desktop Client documentation says: LAN sync accelerates transfers between devices on the same local network without going through the cloud. The client lets you throttle upload and download bandwidth per network in Settings > Network, so a metered hotspot is never drained by background syncs. On paid plans, "Smart Sync" learns your working hours and schedules large transfers for off-peak times. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
